categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Touches prevout preparation and allocation reuse in block validation, carrying the 'UTXO Db and Indexes' label.
categories.rationale: Optimizes memory allocations and task dispatching during prevout preparation, but the performance payoff is unmeasured. As noted by the author, it is a 'Draft until reindex-chainstate performance is measured,' making it currently an unmeasured micro-optimization.
